description: As someone who was born and raised here in the 100th district, who has lived here for more than 50 years, and has worked on and watched farms and farming change during the decades, I find myself growing increasingly possessive of Lancaster County and its traditions. Growing up on a hog farm in the 1970s and 80s, I learned firsthand the value of hard labor and the connection between our people and the land.
